Priya Narang: Quick heads-up  compact QBR with Polaris next Thu (15m). SVP Product attending. Need one-slide exec asks, current onboarding blockers, renewal pulse, and named owners. Deck: https://tiny.redwood/polaris-qbr

Noah Green: I'll paste 30d active seats + week-by-week activation chart into slide 3.

Ivy Park: Renewal pulse = yellow. Top risks: stalled SSO claim mapping, analytics export not enabled, and low adoption in second week. Recommend asking for short-term credits + prioritized export access.

Samira Khan: I can lead a 48-hour enablement sprint to target stalled accounts. Need approval for 6 SE-hours. I'll craft a 1-page runbook.

Priya Narang: Please add a 1-line "ask for exec" into slide 1 by EOD today. Keep it decisive (approve pilot extension / allocate enablement hours / prioritize export).

Leo Ortiz: Invites sent to SVP Product and Head of Ops. I'll make the slide "decision needed" very explicit.

Noah Green: Uploaded charts. Notable: 19% drop after onboarding week 1. Added assumptions in notes.

Ivy Park: SSO ticket assigned to Polaris infra, ETA Wed EOD. Analytics export escalation to product manager in progress.

reminder-bot: Reminder set: final deck review on 2025-10-12 16:00.

Priya Narang: Action items (pasting here so thread is the source of truth):
```
- Samira: enablement sprint plan + SE-hours request (due Tue EOD)
- Noah: data slides + retention appendix (due Wed noon)
- Ivy: SSO + export status update (due Wed 5pm)
- Leo: exec slide + invite confirmation (done)
- Priya: collect customer quote + finalize asks (due Thu morning)
```

Samira Khan: Will post the sprint runbook by Tue and prepare a 2-slide appendix for the deck.

Noah Green: I'll be on the dry run.

Priya Narang: Dry run scheduled Wed 08:30 (12m). Please keep remarks to 90s each. If any red flags pop up, drop them here. :rocket:
